title: Alua
name: alua
short_description: Autonomous companion with follow, memory, recall and sensor commands.
long_description:
Alua is an experimental autonomous companion and living-world framework for Luanti, currently tested with Mineclonia.

Current playable features:
- persistent owner-bound companion entity
- autonomous follow behaviour
- stay/follow switching by command or right-click
- recall to the owner
- simple persistent memory of the owner's last seen position
- local diagnostic sensor report and status command
- one active companion per player

The long-term architecture separates world rules, AI cognition, population, economy, society, story and debugging. Mineclonia is used as a test environment while Alua's own systems remain modular and portable.

The project is Work in Progress.
